name: immunoglobulin lambda like polypeptide 5

function.text: IGLL5 encodes immunoglobulin lambda-like polypeptide 5. Annotated molecular activities include antigen binding. It participates in immunoglobulin mediated immune response.

function.text: IGLL5 encodes an immunoglobulin lambda-like polypeptide within the lambda locus. Unlike conventional rearranging immunoglobulin genes, its expression does not require somatic rearrangement. Its first exon is unrelated to immunoglobulin variable segments, whereas later exons correspond to lambda joining and constant segments. This organization distinguishes IGLL5 from an ordinary rearranged antibody light-chain gene.
